Type: dresser
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Dresser, 60"W, Weathered Oak
Colors: Weathered Oak
Materials: Oak
A great addition to any bedroom, this handcrafted transitional dresser blends effortlessly with most décor. Its natural oak finish brings out the wood grain detail. 17"L x 60"W x 34"H 100% constructed by hand Assemble in 30 minutes-1 hour with two people Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty
